description: This header file declares functions and macros related to the CCSP PSM (Persistent Storage Module) interface, including record value set/get, deletion, enumeration, and instance retrieval. It provides an API for interacting with persisted configuration or state data within the CCSP framework.

methods.name: PSM_Set_Record_Value
methods.description: Sets the value of a record identified by its name and type, using a PSLAP_VARIABLE as the value.

methods.name: PSM_Get_Record_Value
methods.description: Retrieves the value and type of a record specified by its name, storing the type in an output parameter.

methods.name: PSM_Del_Record
methods.description: Deletes a record identified by its name.

methods.name: PsmGetNextLevelInstances
methods.description: Retrieves the list of instances at the next level under the specified parent path.

methods.name: PsmEnumRecords
methods.description: Enumerates all records under a specified parent path, with optional recursive enumeration.

methods.name: PSM_Set_Record_Value2
methods.description: Sets the value of a record using a string value instead of PSLAP_VARIABLE.

methods.name: PSM_Get_Record_Value2
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a record as a string, along with its type.

methods.name: PSM_Reset_UserChangeFlag
methods.description: Resets the user change flag for a specific record.
